sentences.ar: البحارة طلعوا برا وحكوا مع بعض.
sentences.en: The sailors went outside and talked together.
They came back and gave Silver a paper.

sentences.ar: عليها نقطة سودا، زي اللي شفتها زمان.
sentences.en: On it was a black spot, like the one I had seen long ago.
Silver looked at it and laughed.

sentences.ar: طلّع الخريطة من جيبه ورماها لهم.
sentences.en: He took the map from his pocket and threw it to them.

sentences.ar: وأنا كنت بعرف إشي هم ما بيعرفوه.
sentences.en: And I knew something they did not know.
